_metadata.message: Source-backed movement concepts are available; specific Adavu mappings are not established.
_metadata.source: Mauritius Institute of Education; Kalaprangan Trust; Eambalam
_metadata.source_reference: Bharata Natyam Grade 9, Chapter 5 — Adavus; Bharatanatyam Praveshika Purna, Adavu section; The Structure of Bharathanatyam, Adavu section

entries.source: Mauritius Institute of Education, Bharata Natyam Grade 9
entries.notes: Describes Adavus as basic units of Nritta with prescribed movement sequences. This category is not a direct translation of story actions; terminology and classification may vary by lineage.

entries.source_reference: Section 'Adavu' — Sthanaka as a movement component
entries.notes: Structural movement concept only; no story-action mapping or specific Adavu is asserted.

entries.source_reference: Section 'Adavu' — Chari and coordinated movement components
entries.notes: A travelling movement concept. A forward-entry intent may use Chari as a movement-concept candidate only; this does not identify a specific Adavu or claim that Chari means 'enter'. Terminology may vary by lineage.

entries.source_reference: Adavu section — Bhramari as a turning/rotational movement concept
entries.notes: A turning/rotational movement concept, not a specific Adavu assignment or a universal translation of the story verb 'turn'. Terminology may vary by lineage.

entries.source_reference: Section 'Adavu' — Nritta Hasta as a movement component
entries.notes: Structural hand/arm component only; it does not establish an action mapping for story gestures or raised hands.

entries.source_reference: Adavu section — coordinated movement of neck, head and eyes
entries.notes: Source-backed structural coordination only. Looking toward a story object is not asserted as a Bharatanatyam movement mapping.
